definitions.name: KIP126.Classical.Adams.TowerDetection.Detects
definitions.excerpt:
def Detects (c : Convergence unit X) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (x : (adamsTowerInternalSpectralSequence unit X).Page 2 p)
    (α : HomotopyGroup (p.2 - p.1) X) : Prop :=
  let D := (adamsTowerInternalSpectralSequence unit X).ssData p
  ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ),
    (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ 0) z = x ∧
    ∃ a : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((filtration unit X).F p.1 (p.2 - p.1)) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      ((filtration unit X).F p.1 (p.2 - p.1)).arrow a = α ∧
      (c.identification p).hom (D.pageπ ⊤ z) =
        (filtration unit X).toAssociatedGraded p.1 (p.2 - p.1) a

definitions.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.NonzeroSurvival
definitions.excerpt:
def NonzeroSurvival {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p) : Prop :=
  let D := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat
  ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z ⊤) : ModuleCat R),
    (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z n) (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ n) z = x ∧
      D.pageπ ⊤ z ≠ 0

definitions.name: KIP126.Classical.Adams.TowerDetection.Detects
definitions.excerpt:
def Detects (c : Convergence unit X) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (x : (adamsTowerInternalSpectralSequence unit X).Page 2 p)
    (α : HomotopyGroup (p.2 - p.1) X) : Prop :=
  let D := (adamsTowerInternalSpectralSequence unit X).ssData p
  ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z ⊤) : ModuleCat ℤ),
    (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ 0) z = x ∧
    ∃ a : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((filtration unit X).F p.1 (p.2 - p.1)) : ModuleCat ℤ),
      ((filtration unit X).F p.1 (p.2 - p.1)).arrow a = α ∧
      (c.identification p).hom (D.pageπ ⊤ z) =
        (filtration unit X).toAssociatedGraded p.1 (p.2 - p.1) a

  ∀ (m w s : ℤ) (h : w-m ≤ s) (a : BiHom m w (D.nu.functor.obj X)),

definitions.name: KIP126.Literature.Route.BHSLambdaDivisible
definitions.excerpt:
def BHSLambdaDivisible (X : C) (m w s : ℤ) (h : w-m ≤ s)
    (a : BiHom m w (D.nu.functor.obj X)) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : BiHom m (m+s) (D.nu.functor.obj X),
    homotopyRegrade rfl (by rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]; omega)
      (lambdaMultiply (m+s-w).toNat b) = a

definitions.name: KIP126.Kervaire.Route.SphereProductCommutative
definitions.excerpt:
def SphereProductCommutative : Prop :=
  ∀ (m n k l : ℤ) (x : BiHom m n (S_0_0 : Syn)) (y : BiHom k l (S_0_0 : Syn)),
    sphereProduct x y = ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (m * k).natAbs) •
      homotopyRegrade (add_comm k m) (add_comm l n) (sphereProduct y x)

definitions.name: KIP126.Synthetic.Context.S_0_0 / Smn / BiHom
definitions.excerpt:
/-- The synthetic sphere `S^(0,0)`, the monoidal unit. -/
noncomputable def S_0_0 : Syn := 𝟙_ Syn

/-- The bigraded synthetic sphere `S^(m,n)`. -/
noncomputable def Smn (m n : ℤ) : Syn :=
  (SyntheticCategory.biShift (m, n)).obj S_0_0

/-- The bigraded homotopy class type `[S^(m,n), X]`. -/
abbrev BiHom (m n : ℤ) (X : Syn) : Type v := Smn m n ⟶ X

definitions.name: KIP126.Synthetic.Context.sphereProduct
definitions.excerpt:
noncomputable def sphereProduct {m n k l : ℤ}
    (x : BiHom m n (S_0_0 : Syn)) (y : BiHom k l (S_0_0 : Syn)) :
    BiHom (m + k) (n + l) (S_0_0 : Syn) :=
  (SyntheticCategory.biShift_comp (m, n) (k, l)).inv.app S_0_0 ≫
    (SyntheticCategory.biShift (k, l)).map x ≫ y

definitions.name: KIP126.Synthetic.Context.homotopyRegrade
definitions.excerpt:
def homotopyRegrade {m m' w w' : ℤ} {X : Syn} (hm : m = m') (hw : w = w')
    (x : BiHom m w X) : BiHom m' w' X := by
  subst m'
  subst w'
  exact x
